sn12.51:1.2: ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Sāvatthiyam viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme || || 2
sn12.51:1.5: Bhadante ti te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosum || || 3
sn12.51:2.1: Kittāvatā nu kho bhikkhave bhikkhu pariviṃsamāno parivīmaṃseyya sabbaso sammādukkhakkhayāyāti || ||
sn12.51:2.2: Bhagavaṃmūlakā no bhante dhammā Bhagavaṃnettikā Bhagavaṃpaṭisaraṇā || sādhu vata bhante Bhagavantaṃ yeva paṭibhātu etassa bhāsitassa attho || Bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantīti || || 4
sn12.51:2.3: Tena hi bhikkhave taṃ suṇātha sādhukaṃ manasi karotha bhāsissāmīti || ||
sn12.51:2.4: Evam bhante ti kho te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ || ||
sn12.51:3.2: Yaṃ kho idam anekavidhaṃ nānappakārakaṃ dukkhaṃ loke uppajjati jarāmaraṇaṃ ||
sn12.51:3.3: idaṃ nu kho dukkhaṃ kiṃnidānaṃ kiṃsamudayaṃ kiṃjātikaṃ kimpabhavaṃ || ||
sn12.51:3.4: kismiṃ sati jarāmaraṇaṃ hoti || kismiṃ asati jarāmaraṇaṃ na hotīti || || 6
sn12.51:3.6: Yaṃ kho idam anekavidhaṃ nānappakarakaṃ dukkhaṃ loke uppajjati jarāmaraṇaṃ || idaṃ kho dukkhaṃ jātinidānaṃ jātisamudayaṃ jātijātikaṃ jātipabhavaṃ || ||
sn12.51:3.7: Jātiyā sati jarāmaraṇaṃ hoti || jātiyā asati jarāmaraṇaṃ na hotīti || || 7
sn12.51:4.1: So jarāmaraṇaṃ ca pajānāti jarāmaraṇasamudayaṃ ca pajānāti jarāmaraṇanirodhaṃ ca pajānāti || yā ca jarāmaraṇanirodhasāruppagāminī paṭipadā taṃ ca pajānāti || || Tathā paṭipanno ca hoti anudhammacārī || || 8
sn12.51:4.2: Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu sabbaso sammādukkhakkhayāya paṭipanno jarāmaraṇanirodhāya || || 9
sn12.51:7.10: Saṅkhārā panime kinnidānā kiṃsamudayā kiṃjātikā kiṃpabhāvā ||
sn12.51:7.11: kismiṃ sati saṅkhārā honti kismiṃ asati saṅkhārā na hontī ti || || 10
sn12.51:7.14: Avijjāya sati saṅkhārā honti || avijjāya asati saṅkhārā na hontī ti || || 11
sn12.51:8.1: So saṅkhāre ca pajānāti saṅkhārasamudayañca pajānāti saṅkhāranirodhañ ca pajānāti || yā ca saṅkhārānirodhasāruppagāminī paṭipadā taṃ ca pajānāti || || Tathā paṭipanno ca hoti anudhammacārī || ||
sn12.51:8.2: Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu sabbaso sammādukkhakkhayāya paṭipanno saṅkhāranirodhāya || || 12
sn12.51:9.1: Avijjāgato yaṃ bhikkhave purisapuggalo puññaṃ ce saṅkhāram abhisaṃkharoti || puññūpagaṃ hoti viññāṇaṃ ||
sn12.51:9.2: apuññaṃ ce saṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti || apuññūpagaṃ hoti viññāṇaṃ ||
sn12.51:9.3: Āneñjam ce saṅkhāram abhisaṅkharoti || āneñjūpagaṃ hoti viññānaṃ || || 13
sn12.51:9.4: Yato kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno avijjā pahīnā hoti vijjā uppannā || so avijjāvirāgā vijjuppādā-n-eva puññabhisaṅkhāram abhisaṅkharoti || na apuññābhisaṅkhāram abhisaṅkharoti || na ānejābhisaṅkhāram abhisaṅkharoti || || 14
sn12.51:9.5: Anabhisaṅkharonto anabhisañcetayanto na kiñci loke upādiyati ||
sn12.51:9.6: anupādiyaṃ na paritassati || aparitassaṃ paccattaññeva parinibbāyati ||
sn12.51:9.7: khīṇā jāti || vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparam itthattāyā ti pajānāti || || 15
sn12.51:10.1: So sukham ce vedanaṃ vedayati || sā aniccāti pajānāti || anajjhositā ti pajānāti || anabhinanditāti pajānāti || || Dukkhaṃ ce vedanam vedayati || sa aniccā ti pajānāti || anajjhositāti pajānāti || anabhinanditā ti pajānāti || || Adukkham asukhaṃ ce vedanaṃ vedayati || sā aniccāti pajānāti || anajjhositāti pajānāti ||
sn12.51:10.4: So sukhaṃ ce vedanaṃ vedayati visaññutto taṃ
sn12.51:10.6: vedanaṃ vedayati visaññutto taṃ vedanaṃ vedayati || adukkham asukhaṃ ce vedanaṃ vedayati visaññutto taṃ vedanaṃ vedayati || 17
sn12.51:11.1: So kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyamāno kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyāmīti pajānāti || jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyamāno jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyāmīti pajānāti ||
sn12.51:11.2: kāyassa bhedā uddhaṃ jīvitapariyādānā idheva sabbavedayitāni anabhinanditāni sītibhavissanti || sarīrāni avasissantīti pajānāti || || 18
sn12.51:12.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso kumbhakārapākā uṇhaṃ kumbham uddharitvā same bhūmibhāge patiṭṭhapeyya
sn12.51:12.2: tatra yāyam usmā sa tattheva vūpasameyya kapallāni avasiseyyuṃ ||
sn12.51:12.3: evam eva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyamāno kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyāmīti pajānāti || jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vedijamāno jivitapariyantikam vedanam vediyāmīti pajānāti ||
sn12.51:12.4: kāyassa bhedā uddhaṃ jīvitapariyādānā idheva sabbavedayitāni anabhinanditāni sītibhavissanti || sarīrāni avassissantīti pajānāti || || 19
sn12.51:13.2: api nu kho khīnāsavo bhikkhu puññābhisaṅkhāraṃ vā abhisaṅkhareyya apuññābhisaṅkhāram vā abhisaṅkhareyya āneñjābhisaṅkhāram vā abhisaṅkhareyyāti || ||
sn12.51:14.1: Sabbaso vā pana saṅkhāresu asati saṅkharānirodhā api nu kho viññāṇaṃ paññayethāti || ||
sn12.51:15.1: Sabbaso vā pana viññāṇe asati saṅkhāranirodhā api nu kho nāmarūpaṃ paññāyethāti || ||
sn12.51:16.1: Sabbaso vā nāmarūpe asati nāmarūpanirodhā api nu kho saḷāyatanaṃ paññāyethāti || ||
sn12.51:17.1: Sabbaso vā pana saḷāyatane asati saḷāyatananirodhā api nu kho phasso paññāyethāti || ||
sn12.51:18.1: Sabbaso vā pana phasse asati phassanirodhā api nu kho vedanā paññāyethāti || ||
sn12.51:19.1: Sabbaso vā pana vedanāya asati vedanānirodhā api nu kho taṇhā paññāyethāti || ||
sn12.51:20.1: Sabbasso vā pana taṇhāya asati taṇhānirodhā api nu kho upādānam paññāyethāti || ||
sn12.51:21.1: Sabbaso vā pana upādāne asati upādānanirodhā api nu kho bhavo paññāyethāti || ||
sn12.51:22.1: Sabbaso vā pana bhave asati bhavanirodhā api nu kho jāti paññāyethāti || ||
sn12.51:23.1: Sabbaso vā pana jātiyā asati jātinirodhā api nu kho jarāmaraṇaṃ paññāyethāti || ||
sn12.51:24.1: Sādhu sādhu bhikkhave || evam etam bhikkhave netam aññathā || ||
sn12.51:24.2: Saddahatha me tam bhikkhave adhimuccatha nikkaṅkhā ettha hotha nibbicikicchā ||
